title: All Contacts Backup & Restore
summary: Caller name announcer, contacts backup, and deleted messages recovery app.
description:
✨ Whether you want to know who is calling without touching your phone, recover deleted WA messages 💬, backup IG chats 📲, or save all your contacts securely 📂 — this Caller Name Announcer 📞, Contacts Backup 📂, and Deleted Messages Recovery 💬 app has everything you need.

📂 Contacts Backup & Restore
🔐 Easily backup contacts to Google Drive ☁️ and keep your phonebook safe forever.
📱 Works as a secure contacts backup and restore tool that saves all your numbers in a single file.
📤 Whether you need to restore deleted contacts, transfer contacts to a new phone 📲, or create a google contacts backup ☁️, our app makes it fast and reliable.
✅ With just one tap, you can perform a backup all contacts to Google Drive safely and restore them whenever you need.

📞 Caller Name Announcer
🔊 Our caller name announcer app speaks the name of incoming callers.
🚗 Perfect for driving, working, or busy moments when you can’t look at your phone.
👤 The call name speaker announces caller ID in real time, helping you decide whether to answer or ignore a call.
🎨 Personalize your experience with multiple caller themes 🎭 and voice options.
🙌 With the incoming call announcer, you’ll always stay hands-free and informed.

💬 Deleted Messages Recovery & Message Backup
📩 Never miss a message again! With our deleted messages recovery feature, you can easily view and restore texts deleted by senders.
✔ Recover deleted WA messages 📱 instantly from notifications
✔ View deleted IG chats 📷 even after they disappear
✔ Works as a message saver app 💾 that stores all notifications inside your phone
✔ Use it as a message backup app 🔐 for WA, IG, and more
✔ Helps you undelete messages ↩️ and maintain a chat history backup 🗂️

📑 All recovered messages are stored within the application, so you can read them later, even if the sender deletes them. With this app, your notification history becomes your personal message backup tool 📥.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: How do I recover deleted WA messages? 📱
You can easily recover deleted messages on WA using our notification history recovery 🔎 feature.

Q2: Can I recover deleted IG chats? 📷
Yes! Our deleted messages recovery app allows you to restore IG chats deleted from notifications.

Q3: How can I backup my contacts? 📂
Simply open the contacts backup section in the app and choose “Backup to Google Drive ☁️.”

Q4: Can I restore deleted contacts? 🔄
Absolutely! With our contacts backup & restore option, you can restore from Google Drive anytime.

Q5: Does the caller name announcer work hands-free? 🎤
Yes, the call announcer app works automatically and speaks the caller name aloud.

Q6: How can I change my incoming caller theme? 🎭
You can personalize calls with multiple caller themes and styles inside the app.

📲 Download Call Name Announcer & Backup today and enjoy it!

Disclaimer: This app uses notification access to recover deleted messages and gives you option to backup contacts into your google drive. It does not collect or share your personal information.
